Picking this up 👀

**Question:** Which is the smallest city in Pakistan?

**Answer:** Pakistan has no officially designated "smallest city". The 2023 census reports population by urban area but doesn't rank cities from smallest to largest, and where a town ends and a city begins isn't defined consistently. Most city rankings, such as Wikipedia's [List of cities in Pakistan by population](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cities_in_Pakistan_by_population), only include places with 100,000 or more people, and treat smaller urban areas as towns (see [List of towns in Punjab by population](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_towns_in_Punjab,_Pakistan_by_population)).

So the honest answer depends on the cut-off you use. For a definitive ranking, the [Pakistan Bureau of Statistics 2023 census tables](https://www.pbs.gov.pk/) list the population of every urban locality.

title: which is the smallest city in pakistan
